title: high-radix-fp-fpga: VHDL floating-point adders, multipliers and converters for high-radix formats on FPGAs
description:
Synthesizable VHDL floating-point adders, multipliers and IEEE-754 converters for high-radix floating-point formats (radix 16, 64, 256, 4096 and 224) aimed at FPGA implementation, together with a Python reference model and self-checking tests for GHDL.

The formats and the architectures are described in J. Villalba and J. Hormigo, "High-Radix Formats for Enhancing Floating-Point FPGA Implementations", Circuits, Systems, and Signal Processing 41, 1683-1703, 2022.
